name: ACCOUNTING_CALENDAR_TYPE
description: This entity supports all types of accounting or fiscal calendars as required by the enterprise.

description: This entity tracks the changes to the Internal Accounting Currency (IAC) over time. For example, if the country is Germany, then the internal accounting currency could be marks. description: This minor entity specifies the type of accounting currency such as global or local currency.

description: The entity that provides details of ACCOUNTS PAYABLE for a company. ACCOUNTS PAYABLE records how much a company owes suppliers for the purchase of supplies or services on credit.

name: ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE
description: The entity that provides details for the ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE accounts. ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE is the payment a company expects to collect from a PARTY, generally from a completed transaction of sales or services rendered. ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE accounts are types of current assets.

name: ACCOUNT_INVOLVEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: This is a subtype discriminator that indicates whether the enterprise is one of the parties to the account. "Internal" indicates the enterprise is a party to the account, and "external" indicates that the enterprise is not a party to the account.

name: ACCOUNT_METRIC
description: This entity contains any kind of metric applicable to this account over time such as current monetary balance, current point balance, and current past due balance amount. This entity can track any kind of metric over time.

name: ACCOUNT_METRIC_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of metric such as current monetary balance, current point balance, and current past due balance amount.

name: ACCOUNT_PURPOSE_SUBTYPE
description: This is a subtype discriminator based on the purpose of the account such as a transaction account or a loyalty account.

name: ACCOUNT_RENEWAL
description: This entity tracks history information regarding account renewal start and end dates for renewable accounts. Each instance is one renewal period including the original or first period.

name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
description: This is a classification of the account.

name: ACCRUED_LIABILITY_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the accrued liabilities. Accrued liabilities recognize expenses incurred during the accounting period but not yet paid.

name: AFFILIATE_PRODUCT_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement between the financial institution and a company to provide financial products to that company's employees at a discount.

name: AGENCY_CREDIT_REPORT
description: This is the credit report containing data elements specific to an agency such as Experian, Equifax, and Trans-Union. name: AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains information about arrangements between two or more parties where there are terms and conditions. It includes legally binding contracts and arrangements that are not legally binding.

description: This entity identifies relationships between agreements and applications.

description: This minor entity contains the role of the asset to the contract and is used as a subtype code. Roles can include is collateral for, is insured asset for, or is subject of a lease.

description: This entity identifies the enterprise-supplied request for immediate scheduling of a delivery against a VENDOR PO LINE. The PO DELIVERY RELEASE can, for example, allow a blanket purchase order to be delivered in pieces over time and to specify the delivery schedule just in time.

name: PO_DELIVERY_RELEASE_LINE_ITEM
description: This entity defines the authorization by enterprise of a particular delivery of a release quantity that was requested, based on a particular PO LINE DELIVERY RELEASE LINE.

name: PO_DELIVERY_RELEASE_STATUS
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a PO DELIVERY RELEASE LINE ITEM over time.

name: PO_LINE_DELIVERY_RELEASE_LINE
description: This entity associates the VENDOR PO LINE to the PO DELIVERY RELEASE LINE ITEM. It identifies the quantity of the VENDOR PO LINE that has been authorized for release.

name: PO_RELEASE_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: Lists the possible reasons for a PO DELIVERY RELEASE STATUS.  For example, the reason a PO release reflects a status of on hold could be due to a pending change in delivery schedule.

name: PO_RELEASE_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the types of purchase order release status.  Examples: - Incomplete - In process - Approved - Preapproved - Rejected - Returned - Requires reapproval - On hold - Frozen - Open - Closed - Finally closed - Canceled

name: PRECREDIT_TYPE
description: The charges before starting the actual regular payments on a mortgage. Sample values are prepayment charges and preinterest amount.

name: PREFERRED_STOCK_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies dividend equity as preferred stock. Preferred stock has preference over common stock in the payment of dividends and the liquidation of assets.

name: PREMIUM_WRITTEN_ACCOUNT
description: The GL account for the amount of policy premiums billed less premiums returned to the insured.

name: PREPAID_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the PREPAID EXPENSE ACCOUNTs. Prepaid expenses are those expenses that have been paid in advance like insurance. PREPAID EXPENSE ACCOUNTs are types of current assets.

name: PRODUCT_TO_AGREEMENT_CLASS_VALUE
description: This entity was created for the Loss Give Default Business Function View for enterprise risk management.  This entity classifies a product according to a certain classification scheme. name: PROJECT_TASK_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS
description: This entity associates project tasks and resources to a chart of accounts number to enable revenue and expense reporting for the project.

name: PROMOTION_COLLATERAL
description: This entity identifies the communication collateral associated with a promotion.

name: PROPERTY_CASUALTY_AGREEMENT
description: This entity is a subtype to INSURANCE AGREEMENT and contains the details of applications for property and casualty insurance.

name: PROPOSAL_AGREEMENT
description: This entity relates an agreement to a proposal that may have triggered the creation of this agreement. It allows for an agreement to be triggered by many proposals and for a proposal to result in many agreements.  This allows for the creation of an agreement without the existence of an opportunity.

name: PROVIDER_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: Code indicating the type of agreement under which the provider is submitting this claim. One example is a nonparticipating provider is sending a participating claim as allowed under certain plans.

name: PROVISION_FOR_LOAN_LOSS_ACCOUNT
description: This provision account is really a noncash expense. Its purpose is to shelter a portion of the bank's current earnings from taxes in order to help prepare for a bad loan. The annual loan loss provision is deducted from the current revenues before taxes are applied to earnings.

name: PURCHASED_RECEIVABLE_ISSUER_AGREEMENT
description: This agreement contains information about the agreement between the bank and the issuer for whom the bank is to collect receivables for. name: PURCHASED_RECEIVABLE_ISSUER_DEBTOR_AGREEMENT
description: A purchased receivable contract in which the following parties are involved. name: PURCHASE_TRANSACTION_AGREEMENT
description: This is a type of credit card and represents accounts that allow purchasing only at specific business organization types.

name: QUOTATION_AGREEMENT
description: This associative entity defines the hierarchical relationship that will exist between existing accounts and the account that this quotation might be converted into. name: QUOTATION_COLLATERAL_ASSET
description: This is a subtype to entity QUOTATION ASSET and contains details of the asset in relation to the quotation in the role of to be collateral.

description: Reinsurance is a means by which an insurance company can protect itself against the risk of losses with other insurance companies. Individuals and corporations obtain insurance policies to provide protection for various risks (e.g., hurricanes, earthquakes, and lawsuits ).

name: REINSURANCE_AGREEMENT_RESTRICTION
description: This entity identifies each restriction to the reinsurance agreement. This is in addition to the terms and conditions as described in Features. description: This minor entity converts the reinsurance contract type code into a description. name: RELEASE_TYPE
description: Describes whether release is for a blanket or planned purchase order. Possible values are therefore "Blanket" or "Planned."

name: REPURCHASE_AGREEMENT
description: This is a form of short-term borrowing for dealers in government securities. name: REPURCHASE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity indicates if this is a repurchase agreement, or a reverse repurchase agreement, or a securities lending agreement.

name: RESEARCH_DEVELOPMENT_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the operating expense pertains to research and development. Research and development expenses are related to research and development of products or services for a company.

name: RESERVES_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the reserves. Reserves are the accrual of anticipated expenses to be paid out in the future, such as product liability, and litigation.

name: RETAINED_EARNING_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies a NONDIVIDEND EQUITY ACCOUNT as retained earnings. Retained earnings are net profits kept to accumulate in a business after dividends are paid.

name: REVENUE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates a general ledger account is a REVENUE ACCOUNT. Types of REVENUE ACCOUNTs include interest income and other revenue.

name: REVENUE_ACCOUNT_REVENUE_TYPE_XREF
description: This entity associates a REVENUE TYPE with REVENUE ACCOUNT. The many-to-many relationship allows for a more flexible way to roll up GL accounts to various revenue types. For example, roll up all GL revenue account for product revenue types.

name: REVENUE_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that indicates the type of revenue account. Types of revenue accounts include sales revenue and other revenue.

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT_ITEM
description: This entity relates a risk mitigant agreement (e.g., collateral agreement) to the customer asset that the agreement is for (e.g., real estate or customer account). The terms of the agreement describe how this asset can be used as collateral.

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT_RELATED
description: This entity contains information about the relationship between two different risk mitigant agreements. Examples of the relationship could be "is senior to" or "is equal in seniority to" when both risk mitigant agreements cover the same exposure.

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT_SENIORITY
description: This entity tracks the history of seniority of one risk mitigant agreement to another risk mitigant agreement. name: SAFE_DEPOSIT_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains information about safe deposit boxes.

name: SALES_REVENUE_ACCOUNT
description: A type of REVENUE ACCOUNT that provides details on revenue from delivery of goods and services. Sales revenue is the primary source of revenue earned by the company from its customers.

name: SEARCH_ENGINE_ACCOUNT_CAMPAIGN_XREF
description: This entity captures information that provides a linkage between paid search accounts and paid search campaigns.

name: SEARCH_ENGINE_SYSTEM_ACCOUNT
description: This entity captures customer paid search engine system access account information.

name: SECURITIES_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the SECURITIES ACCOUNTs. Securities are short-term investments with a maturity of three to twelve months. Securities accounts are types of current assets.

name: SECURITIZATION_AGREEMENT_TO_SECURITIZATION_POOL
description: This entity shows those securitization agreements that caused this pool to be formed.

name: SECURITIZATION_CLEAN_UP_CALL_TYPE
description: A code for the option to call a securitized bond when the balance of the outstanding deal assets (collateral) falls below some threshold (typically 10%).

name: SECURITIZATION_EXPOSURE
description: This summary entity tracks various measures of a bank's asset securitization activity, including total current outstanding securitization exposures, and the amount of securitization exposures incurred during the period.

name: SECURITIZATION_POOL

description: In the case where the agreement group is a securitization pool, it is a requirement in Basel to determine all the exposures to the same obligor and the total EAD and LGD for those exposures for that pool for that obligor.  Securitization June 2004 Accord paragraph 633/634

name: SECURITIZATION_POOL_RISK
description: This entity tracks risk related metrics for a securitization pool (group of accounts that are securitized) over time.

name: SECURITIZATION_POOL_STRUCTURE_TYPE
description: A code for whether this securitization pool is traditional or synthetic. name: SECURITIZATION_ROLE
description: The role played by the bank in an asset securitization transaction, for example, originator, investor, servicer, and sponsor of asset-backed commercial paper facility.

name: SECURITIZATION_SELL_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement between the loan-originating bank (your enterprise as the seller) and an investing bank (or other investor) that is purchasing and assuming the risk on an underlying exposure (e.g., loan). name: SECURITIZATION_TYPE
description: A classification of the type of securitization sale this agreement represents.  Examples: - Mortgage-backed security - Loan backed bonds - Sponsoring agreement to an asset-backed commercial paper (issuing notes against receivable

name: SELLING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The operating expense category that indicates selling expenses, related to the actual selling of a product, for example, sales salaries and commissions.

name: SETTLEMENT_DELIVERY_TYPE
description: A code for the method of delivery of the goods such as: - B = Book (security being traded is registered in the street name where the brokerage is designated the security nominee by the client. description: Indicates whether your enterprise is the deliverer, the receiver or both of the settlement.  Examples: - D = delivery - R = receive - B = delivery and receive

name: SETTLEMENT_PRODUCT_REASON_TYPE
description: A code for the reason this group of products is associated with this settlement instruction such as "applies to" and "does not apply to."

name: SHORT_TERM_DEBT_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the short-term debt. Short-term debt is all debt obligations coming due within one year.

name: SPLIT_SETTLEMENT_TYPE
description: Indicates whether the settlement of securities is handled separate from cash settlement.  Examples: - Together - Separate

name: STORED_VALUE_AGREEMENT
description: STORED VALUE AGREEMENT is a type of FINANCIAL AGREEMENT, implemented as a prepaid card, single use or renewable with new deposits of money. This entity contains only those card member agreements that are liabilities from the company's perspective. An example of a STORED VALUE AGREEMENT is a gift car

name: STRESS_TEST_AGREEMENT_GROUP
description: This entity identifies the group of agreements or 'portfolio' that is being tested or stressed as a result of this test.

name: SWAP_AGREEMENT
description: A swap is an agreement between two parties to exchange future streams of cash flows generated from other agreements (e.g., loans). Swaps involve exchanging the terms of one asset (loan) for another to improve the quality of a loan portfolio for risk management or asset/liability management purposes.

name: SWAP_AGREEMENT_LEG
description: This entity identifies the cash flow terms for a swap agreement. name: SWAP_AGREEMENT_LEG_METRIC
description: This entity tracks metrics for swap leg. This can be any calculated metric associated with the swap leg (other than what is specified in the other entities) such as exposure amount and volatility.

name: SWAP_LEG_AGREEMENT_EVENT
description: This entity contains information about events that affects the leg of a swap such as payments against a specific leg.

name: TARGET_PROMOTION_AGREEMENT
description: This associative entity allows for a campaign strategy, such as a collection/recovery campaign promotion, to target more than one account and for an account to be targeted by more than one promotion.

name: TARGET_PROMOTION_AGREEMENT_GROUP
description: This associative entity allows for a campaign, such as a collection/recovery campaign promotion, to target more than one account group and for an account group to be targeted by more than one promotion.

name: TRADE_SETTLEMENT_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement between the firm and a third party (e.g., custodian or agency) and specifies the terms and conditions for all trades under this agreement with these third parties. This entity contains the third-party identifiers.

name: TRADE_SETTLEMENT_INSTRUCTION
description: This entity contains those predefined settlement instructions that are considered standing instructions at the account level and do not vary by trade. name: TRADE_SETTLEMENT_PRODUCT_GROUP
description: This entity contains the group of products that are the class of securities that this settlement instruction covers at the account level. This allows for an instruction to cover multiple product groups for different reasons.

description: This entity identifies any agreement or account that is related to a tranche.  If the agreement is the exposure (e.g., a loan) then this shows which tranches that loan was put into. description: The role that the agreement has with the tranche such as "is being securitized by" or "is risk mitigant for."

name: TRANSACTION_ACCOUNT
description: This is the account that is used by the financial institution to pay for invoices and other debt. It is not a customer account.

name: TRANSACTION_ACCOUNT_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the type of transaction account such as credit card account, checking account, or current account.

name: TREASURY_STOCK_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies a NONDIVIDEND EQUITY ACCOUNT as Treasury stock. Treasury stock is reacquired by a corporation to be retired or resold to the public. name: UNDERWRITING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: A broad classification of expense excluding loss adjustment and investment expenses. Underwriting expenses include acquisition, field supervision, collections, taxes, licenses, and fees.

name: UNEARNED_PREMIUM_RESERVE_ACCOUNT
description: The unearned premium reserve is the liability for the unearned portion of premium of a policy in force or the amount required to provide for losses and expenses during the unexpired term of the policy.

name: UNITED_STATES_BANK_ACCOUNT_IDENTIFIER
description: This is the bank account number that is assigned to a bank account for a financial institution in the United States, and which follows the numbering system as assigned by the American Bankers Association including a routing transit number. name: UNPAID_CLAIM_ACCOUNT
description: The unpaid claim account is the liability provision for unpaid losses and includes claims approved for payment not yet paid, pending claims, and closed claims reopened for payment.

name: VOTING_STOCK_ACCOUNT
description: This entity identifies common stock equity as a voting stock. Voting stock equities of a public corporation have voting rights.

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_CONTRACT
description: The entity represents the agreement made between the one party and another (e.g., ad service provider and the advertiser) that states the time period for the contract, the number of impressions and click-throughs guaranteed to the advertisers and the cost for each impression and click-through.

name: WORK_PROCESS_LOAN
description: This is the work process required for this loan. The types of work processes could be processing a loan, default remediation, or repossession steps.
